experiences.name: Street Food Tour in Centro Histórico
experiences.description: Explore the bustling street food scene in the heart of Mexico City. Sample tacos de canasta, tlayudas, tamales, and fresh aguas frescas from local vendors around Mercado de San Juan and surrounding streets. A guided walk helps you discover hidden gems and understand the culinary history of each dish.

experiences.name: Visit Templo Mayor and National Museum of Anthropology
experiences.description: Discover the ancient Aztec ruins of Templo Mayor right in the city center, then head to the nearby National Museum of Anthropology in Chapultepec to explore Mexico's rich pre-Hispanic heritage. Both sites offer deep cultural immersion and are within easy reach of central hotels.

experiences.name: Cooking Class in Roma Norte
experiences.description: Join a hands-on cooking class in the trendy Roma Norte neighborhood where a local chef teaches you to prepare traditional Mexican dishes such as mole, chiles en nogada, and handmade tortillas. Classes are held in a home kitchen setting, offering an authentic and intimate cultural experience.

experiences.name: Explore Mercado de Medellín and Condesa Park
experiences.description: Stroll through Mercado de Medellín, a vibrant local market filled with fresh produce, spices, and prepared foods from across Mexico and Latin America. Afterward, relax in the leafy Parque México in Condesa, a beloved neighborhood park surrounded by Art Deco architecture and local café culture.

experiences.name: Evening Mezcal and Taco Crawl in Doctores & Centro
experiences.description: Experience Mexico City's vibrant nightlife with a self-guided or small-group mezcal and taco crawl through the lively streets of Centro and nearby Doctores. Visit traditional cantinas, try regional mezcal varieties, and enjoy late-night tacos de guisado at beloved local spots frequented by residents.
experiences.location: Centro Histórico & Colonia Doctores, Mexico City
